description.description: A series of frames from a surveillance video showing a detention cell marked with the number 5. A woman is seen sitting on the floor in a corner of the room. In the subsequent frames, uniformed officers enter the cell and approach her while she remains on the ground. The image contains social justice commentary overlaying the video frames.
description.ocrText: What happens in these cells... happens to immigrants every day. Behind closed doors. No witnesses. No mercy. Cassandra had a camera. Immigrant women usually don't. 5 POLICE
